alt: Four boxes: a car and garage, travel perks, 10% off in shops, and 10% more cash when selling eligible cars. The four GTA+ perks in GTA 6 story mode.

data.title: The 4 GTA+ perks

cards.title: Car and garage
cards.body: One car plus a one-car garage.

cards.title: Getting around
cards.body: Free rentals and free public transport.

cards.title: 10% off shops
cards.body: Weapons, clothes, hair, tattoos, car mods.

cards.title: +10% car sales
cards.body: More cash for eligible cars you sell.

data.note: Only while you pay for GTA+ (GameSpot, Polygon). Our diagram, not a game screenshot.
